items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions working in Lucky Millinder's band and lists Millinder in a poll ranking; the interviewee (Ernie Fields) does not claim a personal or professional relationship with Millinder, only acknowledging the interviewer's statement.

ctx.x: He was there when we were recording and he was flipping over Melvin Moore.

You do know this: The rumors were that Melvin was in part ownership of your band because he was so loyal, he wouldn't leave. I worked in Lucky Millinder's band and all of us said he should have been a big star.
